# Durability.withTurn() method

Serialize work for one thread and deduplicate the supplied turn identity.

**Signature:**

```typescript
withTurn<T>(identity: {
        readonly threadId: ThreadId;
        readonly turnId: TurnId;
    }, operation: (scope: DurableTurnScope) => Promise<T>): Promise<T>;
```

## Remarks

Production adapters must hold an exclusive thread lease for the complete callback and guarantee atomic commit of result, checkpoint and outbox.
